description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing and querying LoanDelinquencyTagHistory entities, providing methods to find, count, and retrieve loan delinquency history records.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyTagHistoryRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for LoanDelinquencyTagHistory entities, extending JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor for CRUD and complex queries.

methods.name: findFirstByLoanOrderByAddedOnDateDesc
methods.description: Finds the most recent LoanDelinquencyTagHistory record for a given loan.

methods.name: findByLoanOrderByAddedOnDateDesc
methods.description: Retrieves all LoanDelinquencyTagHistory records for a given loan, ordered by addition date descending.

methods.name: findByLoanAndLiftedOnDate
methods.description: Finds the LoanDelinquencyTagHistory record for a specific loan with a particular lifted date.

methods.name: countByDelinquencyRangeAndLiftedOnDate
methods.description: Counts records matching a specific delinquency range and lifted date.

methods.name: countByDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Counts records within a specific delinquency range.

methods.name: findByLoan
methods.description: Finds all LoanDelinquencyTagHistory records associated with a particular loan.
